description: Return the TraydStar profile represented by this request's authenticated credentials. The opaque id is unique within this app and remains unchanged across token refresh, reconnection, and display-metadata changes.
name: get_profile

id.description: Opaque profile identifier, unique within this app and unchanged across token refresh, reconnection, and display-metadata changes. Never reassigned to another profile.

name.description: Display name for the authenticated profile.

nickname.description: A useful label that helps users distinguish connected profiles.

title: Get my TraydStar profile
